name: Elixir
doc: Elixir (battle item; Mega-Potion's code with other sizes and timings, one emitter per target): once its children are gone the actor pools and the stage fade in, then one emitter per target - its sound, the actor system on that target, the master's release, the heal; after the last target a wait, the stage fade out. No camera track. Its parts are the port's code (FFNx mag058_elixir.cpp) run on the program's memory.

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions and uses this memory.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs (its tasks the port's, its parts spawned by them): its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

act.doc: Drain's master in the act family's form: once its children are gone the actor pools carved from the arena top and cleared; the stage in task; after the last action its wait, the stage out task; the actor counters cleared every tick

pools.doc: the actor systems, one per target (the port's)

parts.title: Emitter
parts.doc: One per target: its sound, the actor system, the master's release, the heal; the master's wait

parts.title: Stage fade
parts.doc: The stage fade in before the first target, out after the last one

groups.label: Actor system
groups.doc: At the emitter's start: Start, Length (ticks), Mode

params.label: Release tick
params.doc: The master may go on to the next target at this tick

params.label: Heal tick
params.doc: The heal of its target from this tick

params.label: Wait
params.doc: After the last target, the fade out after these ticks

tasks.doc: One per target: the module's own emitter (the port's task): its sound, the actor system, the master's release, the heal.
The stage fade in (the port's task: the fade layers cleared, their level up a step a tick).
The stage fade out (the port's task: from its level down a step a tick to 0).
